background.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production background texture for the matchmaking window of Corps Royaux, a medieval fantasy pixel-art MMORPG. Generate a wide landscape 4:3 rectangular UI panel, front-facing, straight-on, high-quality hand-painted pixel art with crisp edges, wood grain, dark brown leather, thin antique-gold metal trim and small royal-blue fleur-de-lis cloth accents, consistent with a rich medieval game inventory window. Main center and lower 82 percent must be very dark quiet brown leather, completely empty and readable for software-rendered text, lists and buttons. Narrow decorative top banner: left corner a tiny torch-lit dungeon arch, right corner a tiny sailing ship with cream sails and blue pennant, center a small gold compass medallion and two joined shields symbolizing a team. Decorative border must be narrow, less than six percent width, no weapons intruding into content. Bottom border small fleur-de-lis badge. No text whatsoever, no letters, no numbers, no UI buttons or slots drawn, no characters, no watermark. Opaque rectangle reaching all canvas edges. This is a reusable game UI background, not a screenshot or mockup.

icons.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent sprite atlas of six medieval royal game-interface icons for Corps Royaux, landscape 3:2 aspect ratio, strict regular grid of THREE columns and TWO rows, equal-sized square cells, each object centered perfectly in its own cell, with 15 percent transparent padding all around each object. Crisp detailed hand-painted pixel art, warm antique gold outlines, royal blue cloth, brown leather, medieval fantasy MMORPG inventory style. TOP ROW left to right: (1) ornate gold magnifying glass over two small blue shields, meaning find team; (2) gold-rimmed round emerald green seal with bold ivory checkmark, meaning ready; (3) gold-rimmed crimson red seal with bold ivory X, meaning decline. BOTTOM ROW left to right: (4) compact stone dungeon arch with a glowing amber torch and dark doorway, (5) compact wooden three-masted ship with cream sails and royal blue pennant on a small blue wave, (6) warm gold hourglass with ivory sand and small blue ribbon. Six separate icons only. Preserve real alpha transparency, no backdrop, no shadows extending outside the cells, no card frames, no captions, no labels, no numbers, no watermark. This is a production sprite sheet, not an interface mockup.
icons.edit_prompt: Edit this exact six-icon sprite sheet only to REMOVE THE WHITE BACKGROUND and all faint grid lines, replacing them with true fully transparent alpha. Preserve the six objects, their original positions, dimensions, colors, and clean pixel-art outlines unchanged. Keep exact 1536 x 1024 canvas, regular grid three columns by two rows with equal 512x512 cells. Transparent gaps between objects and transparent empty corners. No white matte, no checkerboard painted into the image, no ground shadows. This is an RGBA game sprite atlas: outside each of the six icon silhouettes must be alpha zero. Preserve opaque white checkmark, pale glass and cream ship sails inside the objects.
